purpose: Design for turning the start-design, start-plan and start-requirements skills into orchestrators with a shared context gathering framework using parallel agents and return values.
summary: Orchestrator structure with preparation, input gathering, document creation, review and completion
Responsibility split between orchestrator, gathering agents, main-context authoring, AI review and post-processing
Design decision: authoring stays in main context because user dialogue is impossible in isolated agents
Return value contract: markdown bullet lists, no session directory
Inline prompt templates with search purpose, means and output contract for self-contained agents
Parallel gathering with failure handling that skips failed categories and displays progress
start-design inputs: requirements doc identified from context, rules via rules agent
start-plan phases and gather matrix for specs, rules and code agents
start-requirements agent matrix per mode and reverse-engineering sequence
Existing components used and the rationale for not using sessions
tasks: Modifying start-design, start-plan or start-requirements skills
